answer.book: A printed funeral oration (Heidelberg, 1585) by Io. Iacobi Grynaeus on the death of Friedrich Widebram: a title page, a dedication and a rector's programma, the oration itself, then a group of funeral poems and an Ignatius-verse section.

entries.title: Oratio Io. Iacobi Grynaei, de vita et morte reverendi et clarissimi viri, Friderici Vvidebrami, Doctoris Theologi, Nonis Iunij in Academia Heidelbergensi recitata à Bartholomaeo Pitisco, Grvnbergensi, Silesio. Additae sunt carmina et epitaphia in eiusdem obitum.

Memoriae D. Friderici Vvidebrami, optimi et theologi, & poetae.
